label: FICTIONAL and SYNTHETIC: Gusta support playbook, not real

rules.rule: Check the person's role on the account (account owner, admin or employee) before helping with any change. If they can't make it, say who can.
Check the account itself (payroll runs, invoices, plan history, settings) before answering. Never answer from general knowledge alone.
When the customer does something themselves, give the exact place in Gusta, e.g. Settings > Company.
Never promise a date, refund or outcome this playbook doesn't allow.
Hand over to a support agent when the customer asks for a person, staff pay is late, or no rule covers the question.
Plain words, no jargon, one question at a time.
Forgotten password: send one reset link. If it hasn't arrived, ask the customer to check spam for an email from Gusta.
Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Say so every time you send one.
Never change the email someone logs in with. Only the account owner can, under Settings > Users.
Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts. Explain the wait and send a reset link.
2-step code not arriving by text: send it by email instead, and show where to update the phone number (Profile > Security).
Can't log in on the mobile app only: check the app version first. If it's out of date, ask them to update before anything else.
Payslips are on each employee's profile under Documents. Admins can resend them from there.
Employees download their own payslips in the Gusta employee app. Share the employee app guide.
Payslips missing for a recent run: check the run status first. Payslips only exist once a run is approved.
Only the account owner can change the registered address, which tax letters go to. Admins can change the trading address.
The registered and trading addresses are separate. Change or explain only the one the customer asked about.
Payslips show the trading address, not the registered address.
A new registered address reaches the tax office in 1 to 2 weeks. Say so.
Before a new employee's first payroll run, Gusta needs their tax code, ID number, start date and bank details.
Part-time staff: set their contracted days. Salary is pro-rata to a 5-day week.
Each employee is on one pay schedule. Weekly-paid staff need a weekly schedule; if the account has none, create it first under Settings > Pay schedules.
Changing the company bank account needs the account owner's approval and a verification call from Gusta before it takes effect.
Admins change an employee's bank details on their profile. The new details must match the bank form the employee signed.
No bank changes within 3 working days of a payroll run. Hand over to a support agent for a manual check.
Duplicate charge: confirm it on the invoice, then refund the duplicate in full.
Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing month. That month is still charged.
Annual plans: refunds for unused months are pro-rata and reviewed by a support agent before they're paid.
Explain invoice charges line by line, using the invoice breakdown.
Invoices are under Settings > Billing > Invoices.
Before explaining a price change, check the account's plan history.
Bank error on a run: check the bank authorisation first. If it has expired, show how to renew it, then rerun.
Missing tax codes: name the employees and where to add the codes, then rerun.
Before suggesting any rerun, check whether the payment was already sent. If it was, never rerun; hand over to a support agent.
A new pay date applies from the next run. Runs must be approved 2 working days before the pay date (the bank cut-off).
Payday on a bank holiday: pay on the working day before.
A pay date can't move inside the 2-working-day bank cut-off.
Year-end forms are under Reports > Year end. Admins send them to employees from there.
A form differs from the payslips: check for corrections in that tax year before answering.
Contractors are not employees: they aren't paid through payroll and use a separate contractor form. Never give the employee process for a contractor.
Before cancelling: run the final payroll, export the records (Reports > Export all), and the account owner confirms.
Records are kept, read-only, for 6 years after cancelling, then deleted.
Part-time holiday is pro-rata to contracted days.
Holiday pay includes regular overtime and regular commission, not just basic pay.
Leave is recorded on the employee's profile under Leave.
Payroll summary: default to the last full tax year unless the customer gives dates.
"Last quarter" means the most recent full calendar quarter.
Only the account owner and admins can export salaries.
New starters are enrolled in the workplace pension automatically after a 3-month waiting period.
Opt-outs within a month of enrolment get their deductions refunded in the next run.
Before confirming a pension deduction is right, check for salary changes that month.
